text:
According to the Hermes Agent documentation, DingTalk delivers images via standard **Markdown URL syntax**:

```markdown
![image](url)
```

Direct local file uploads or native media delivery are not supported on DingTalk in the same way as other platforms (like Telegram or Matrix). To deliver images successfully in DingTalk, the image must be hosted at an accessible URL and embedded using the `![image](url)` Markdown format.
